name: False Door Trap

stealth.details: (expert) to see the brick wall behind the edges of the door

disable: DC 27 Thievery (expert) to disable the doorknob trigger

items.name: Explosive Charge
items.text:
Trigger The doorknob is turned

---

Effect The charge behind the door explodes, dealing 2d8+9 fire damage and 2d8+9 piercing damage to all creatures in a 10-foot cone blasting outward from the door (DC 27 basic Reflex save). The sound of the explosion can be heard up to 50 feet away.

text: A black‑powder charge detonates as soon as the doorknob is turned, shattering the door into splinters.
